text: __NOTOC__ Thornbranch Scamps are sprites found in the Wood of Staves on the Wandering Isle. According to Master Shang Xi, they're crueler and more dangerous than the other sprites on the Isle.

Thorned Bloodcups are found through eastern Ashenvale during the quest Gurtar's Request. Guardian Gurtar asks the player to combine Thorned Bloodcups with an Orc-Hair Braid to create a token of affection for his love, Draaka, at Splintertree Post.

__NOTOC__ Thornar Thunderclash is a Wildhammer dwarf and general of the Wildhammer clan found at Shaol'watha in the Hinterlands. After his death at the hands of the Horde, he was succeeded by Thaddus Stoutblow.
The Thousand-Year Guardian is a water spirit located at the Gilded Fan in the Valley of the Four Winds.
Thrall's Crib is a machinima by lagspikefilms. Azeroth's most famous warchief gives a tour of his crib. MzFrLXAYASc
__NOTOC__ Thrashing Pumpkins can be found at Dalson's Farm in Western Plaguelands
Three's Company: 2400 is a player vs. player achievement earned for 2400 personal rating in the 3v3 bracket of the arena.
Three's Company: 2700 is a player vs. player achievement earned for 2700 personal rating in the 3v3 bracket of the arena.
__NOTOC__ Thousand-Year Pickled Egg is a trinket for healers. Its stats scale to your level when acquired.
Thornroot Vest is a quest reward from Ursal the Mauler (quest).
Thornroot Cord is a quest reward from Ursal the Mauler (quest).
Three-Breeze Terrace is nestled between the Ordon Sanctuary high above to the east, the Misty Strand to the west, and a few hundred yards north of the central Celestial Court.
Thought-Bound Miners are level 90 yaungol found at Zan'vess of Dread Wastes.
Thorny Stabbers are podlings located in Iyun Weald in Gorgrond.
Thorny Leaflings are podlings found in Iyun Weald in Gorgrond.
Three-Pronged Blivet drops from Deathblade Shredders and Diamond-Blade Shredders in the Twilight Highlands.
Thornmire is a ravager nest filled with large, thorny vines in southeastern Tanaan Jungle. It lies just south of Lion's Watch, east of Thundertail Wallow, and north of Fang'rila. __NOTOC__
The Thorn Pits are an area in the northwest of the Spires of Arak. It is the home of the and the site of Bladefist Hold.
Those Who Remember is an Azsuna quest. It requires having completed the quest Their Dying Breaths.
The Thorn-Encrusted Mail is a quest reward from Game of Thorns.
Thoughts of Insanity is a Shadow priest artifact trait. It is linked to the Void Siphon (priest artifact trait), Void Corruption, Sinister Thoughts and Touch of Darkness traits.
Thrashbite the Scornful is the second boss in Cathedral of Eternal Night.
The Thousand Boat Bash, aka :Boat Day, is an event in which adventurers go to Thousand Needles and enjoy a day at sea.

Thornton's Cottage is a cottage in Bradensbrook, Val'sharah. It is owned by Alistair Thornton and Anna Thornton. Elizabeth and a dog also live here. Robin Thackeray will drop by every now and then, for a brief chat with Alistair. The Ledger of the Sea Wolf can be found here.
The Thornguards are two Bristleback quilboar who guard the entrance to Thornmantle's Hideout on Red Cloud Mesa.
Thornclaw Broodlings are aranasi found in Suramar and Mardum.
Thorny Spearchucker was a podling located in Gorgrond. It was taken out by the followers sent from the Frostwall and Lunarfall garrisons.

The Thornspeakers are a group of druids located in Drustvar, on Kul Tiras. It was originally founded by the Drust druids, who did not agree with Gorak Tul's war against the human settlers, and left Drust society. Druidism used to be the old ways of the Drust before the days of Tul, whose ways the Thornspeakers consider to have brought disgrace upon the Drust. They are led by Ulfar, the High Thornspeaker and last of the Drust druids.
Thorned Flounder can be fished from Val'sharah in open water or Ancient Mossgill Schools while under the effect of the Drowned Thistleleaf.
The Thousand Year Old Mummy Wraps teaches you to summon Miimii, a mummy companion.

Thrall's Battlegear was a lower rank of the Thrall's Battlegear set, the Horde tier 9 enhancement shaman set. The higher-level set is Triumphant Thrall's Battlegear. The Alliance equivalent of this set is Conqueror's Nobundo's Battlegear.
Thornspeaker Students are humans located at Ulfar's Den in Drustvar.
Three Sheets to the Wind is an exploration achievement earned for acquiring various alcoholic beverages native to Kul Tiras.
Thornheart is the center of Briarback Kraul in Stormsong Valley. Briarback Thornmatrons are performing the same ritual on the ettin, Bramblefist the Maddened, that they use on their brutes.
Thrashbite's Spite drops from Thrashbite the Scornful in the Cathedral of Eternal Night.
Thornmatron's Vinecaller is a quest reward from Terror of the Kraul.
Thornwoven Band drops from Soulbound Goliath in Waycrest Manor.
Thraxi is someone who often deceived her enemies by disguising herself as a brewmaster monk.
The Thornbrace Girdle is a quest reward from The Farmsteads.
The Thornbrace Gauntlets are a quest reward from The Farmsteads.
The Thornbrace Wristguards are a quest reward from Maiev's Trail.
Thrashing Crawgs are crawgs located in the Hall of Sanitation in Uldir.

__NOTOC__ Thovas Base-Camp is campsite located in northern Tiragarde Sound, sitting just west of Hatherford and Boralus. The camp has been established by members of the Explorers' League to investigate the nearby Drust ruin of Gol Thovas. The expedition departed from Boralus with a contingent of the Proudmoore Guard, before establishing themselves near the ruins' entrance. Despite their preparation, the league members and marines were beset by Drust constructs woken at the site. It would only be with the aid of an Alliance champion that the situation could be salvaged, with the constructs pushed back and numerous relics recovered. North Sound Ferry is also found in the area.
The Thornbrace Waistguard is a quest reward from Totemic Call (quest).
The Thornbrace Grips are a quest reward from Totemic Call (quest).
The Thornbrace Chainmail is a quest reward from Entangled Dreams.
The Thornbrace Helm is a quest reward from Entangled Dreams.
Thornguard Ironclaws are druids located in Gol Koval in Drustvar.
Thornback Lizards are lizards located in the Temple of Sethraliss and at Bouldered Bluffs in Vol'dun.
__NOTOC__ Thornspine Saurolisks are saurolisks located in the Blistering Wastes and the outcroppings surrounding the Prickly Grove and Vulpera Hideaway in Vol'dun.

The Threads of Tirion are provided for free by Melvin Shirtson at Light's Hope Chapel in Eastern Plaguelands during Free T-Shirt Day. The rest of the year, it can be purchased for from Skin-Me-Own-Coat Dibblefur in Booty Bay.
Thrallmar Peons are orcs located in Thrallmar in Hellfire Peninsula. A few are found at Spinebreaker Post.
The Thornbrace Spaulders are a quest reward from To Old Friends.
The Thornbrace Boots are a quest reward from To Old Friends.
Thrashneck Gladius is a quest reward from The Deadliest Catch.
Thoughtstealer Vos is a k'thir located in Akhenet Fields in Uldum.

Three Choose One is a dungeon & raid achievement earned by defeating each of the combatants last throughout multiple completions of the Affront of Challengers encounter in the Theater of Pain on Mythic difficulty.
Thorny Necklace was replaced by Gem Studded Bangle in the beta.
Thought Harvester is an Azerite trait available to Shadow priests.
__NOTOC__ Threads of Pride are looted from the Crafter's Crate in Revendreth.

Thornhill Manor is the estate of House Thornhill. The house bears a private mirror directly to the interior of Redelav Tower, used only by the "paramour" of The Countess. The house has been owned by Duke Theotar for eons, until he was banished to the Ember Ward by Sire Denathrius for participating in Prince Renathal's rebellion. He has since reclaimed his home by killing Viscount Nicolae.
__NOTOC__ Thrashspines are gorm located at Tirna Scithe in Ardenweald.
Thoughts in the Lonely Night is a scroll found in the Circle of Scale in the Jade Forest during the Monk Campaign.
The Thread House is a building where aranakk Thread Mistress Leeda can appear.
Thread Mistress Leeda is an aranakk located in the Thread House in Maldraxxus.
Thrallmar Wolf Riders are orcs located in the Hellfire Peninsula.
Threadbare Cloth is bought from Xy'darid at the Bazaar of Tangible Delights just outside Myza's Oasis in Tazavesh, the Veiled Market. It can be traded to Xy'aqida.
Thornsweeper Scythe drops from Wrigglemortis south of Hibernal Hollow in Ardenweald.
Thornshaper Mitts drop from Soulbound Goliath in Waycrest Manor.
Thornroot Hauberk is a quest reward from Ursal the Mauler (quest).
Three-Tooth Armguards are a quest reward from You Flicked a Fine Vine to Leaf Me.
Thorned Links are a quest reward from Stop the Thorncallers.
The Thorn-Knuckled Gloves drop from Alkali in the Everbloom Wilds in Gorgrond.
The Three-Egg Pendant Necklace drops from the Mother of Goren at Magnarok in Frostfire Ridge.
Thrashbite's Cummerbund drops from Thrashbite the Scornful in the Cathedral of Eternal Night.
Thornsnarl Bracers are a world drop and are looted from Elementium Lockbox and Zen'Vorka's Cache.
Thornsnarl Vest is a world drop and is looted from Elementium Lockbox and Zen'Vorka's Cache.
Thornsnarl Greaves are a world drop and are looted from Elementium Lockbox and Zen'Vorka's Cache.
Thornsnarl Gauntlets are a world drop and are looted from Elementium Lockbox and Zen'Vorka's Cache.
Thornsnarl Helm is a world drop and is looted from Elementium Lockbox and Zen'Vorka's Cache.
Thornsnarl Legguards are a world drop and are looted from Elementium Lockbox and Zen'Vorka's Cache.
Thornsnarl Belt is a world drop and is looted from Elementium Lockbox and Zen'Vorka's Cache.
Thorium Greatsword would have been created with Blacksmithing (260); taught by Plans: Thorium Greatsword.
Threatening Necromancer is a Maldraxxi necromancer encountered by adventure companions in the Bone Pits in Maldraxxus.
Thrallmar Riding Wolves are wolves located in Thrallmar in Hellfire Peninsula.
The Thrashing Wind Vambraces drop from The Raging Tempest in the Nokhud Offensive.
__NOTOC__ Threadfinder Pax is a bronze drakonid located at the Artisan's Market in Valdrakken.
__NOTOC__ Threadfinder Fulafong is a blue dragonspawn located at the Artisan's Market in Valdrakken.
__NOTOC__ Thousandbone Tongueslicer is a fish dish created with Dragon Isles Cooking (30); taught by Recipe: Thousandbone Tongueslicer.
Three Minutes or It's Free is an exploration achievement earned by delivering bait to Patient Vaargo in 3 minutes or less!
Thrallgrulgulgul is a murloc found in Azmerloth. He is an alternate version of Thrall.
Three-Card is a black dragonspawn located in Dragonbane Keep in the Waking Shores.
__NOTOC__ Thornmu the Ancient is a proto-dragon located in the Waking Shores.
Thrall's Hearthstone is provided by Thrall to the orc adventurer as an objective during A People in Need of Healing. It is bound to the Broken Tusk inn in Orgrimmar.
Three-Dimensional Compass is looted from the Busted Wyrmhole Generator in Zaralek Cavern.
Thornsided Basilisks are basilisks located at Steelcliff Passage in Thaldraszus.
Thousand Needles Thread Challenge: Bronze is an expansion feature achievement earned by completing Kalimdor Thousand Needles Thread Challenge.
Thousand Needles Thread Challenge: Gold is an expansion feature achievement earned by getting Gold ranked time for Kalimdor Thousand Needles Thread Challenge.
Thousand Needles Thread Challenge: Silver is an expansion feature achievement earned by getting Silver ranked time for Kalimdor Thousand Needles Thread Challenge.
Thousand Needles Thread Reverse Challenge: Bronze is an expansion feature achievement earned by completing Kalimdor Thousand Needles Thread Reverse Challenge.
Thousand Needles Thread Reverse Challenge: Gold is an expansion feature achievement earned by getting Gold ranked time for Kalimdor Thousand Needles Thread Reverse Challenge.
Thousand Needles Thread Reverse Challenge: Silver is an expansion feature achievement earned by getting Silver ranked time for Kalimdor Thousand Needles Thread Reverse Challenge.
Thraexhelm of the Onyx Crucible is sold by Norzko the Proud in Zaralek Cavern for .
Threatening Note is contained in Victorious Contender's Strongbox, Malicia's Hoard and Field Medic's Hazard Payout.
Thousandbite Piranha Collar is sold during the Community Feast by Junnik in Iskaara in the Azure Span for .
Thrashneck Greatblade is an appearance unlocked as a quest reward from Off With Her Head.
Thrown weapons were a type of ranged weapon that caused physical damage.

.]] A threshadon or thresher is a large, long-necked aquatic reptile. They are found in the watery areas of Darkshore, Sholazar Basin, Dustwallow Marsh, the Wailing Caverns, the Wetlands, the Grizzly Hills and other areas. They produce . The threshers of Dustwallow Marsh produce a type of oil that was formerly used to fuel the Theramore lighthouse. Threshadon meat is apparently tastier than crocolisk meat. They can also be found in the waters of Kul Tiras. The Anglepoint Packing District processes them into food.

Thunderaan the Windlord is the Elemental Lord of air and master of Skywall. Formerly known as the Prince of Air, Thunderaan became the new Windlord following the death of Al'Akir during the Cataclysm.

.]] Thunder Ridge is a flooded gorge in northwestern Durotar, just southwest of Orgrimmar. Previously an ancient forest home to many herds of thunder lizards, the ridge was deforested by the humans of Kul Tiras and the machinations of the Burning Blade, before being flooded by the Southfury River during the Cataclysm.
Throwing Weapon Specialization was a tier 6 talent in the Combat rogue tree. Maxing it required a total of 27 points in Combat.
Thun'grim's Axe is a Warrior axe that gives a bonus to stamina.
Thun'grim's Mace is a Warrior mace that gives a bonus to stamina.
Thun'grim's Dagger is a Warrior dagger that gives a bonus to stamina.
Thun'grim's Sword is a Warrior sword that gives a bonus to stamina.
Thunderaan the Windseeker is the expensive part of the quest chain to forge Thunderfury, Blessed Blade of the Windseeker.

The Thunderbrew Distillery is a dwarven tavern in Kharanos. It features trainers for warriors, priests, paladins, mages, rogues, cooking, and first aid. It also has several vendors, along with Innkeeper Belm with the usual services. The distillery is known far and wide for its excellent ale. Grimbooze Thunderbrew used to be the owner of the distillery when Chen Stormstout visited it.
Threggil is a rare grell who runs around water in the western section of Fel Rock in Teldrassil. He is on a 1-2 hour respawn timer.
Through the Dark Portal is the second set of the World of Warcraft Trading Card Game.

Thunder is crafted with Outland Blacksmithing (60); previously taught by weaponsmithing trainers as part of the hammersmithing specialization. The recipe can no longer be learned, since all weaponsmithing trainers were converted to regular blacksmithing trainers in . It was not removed from the recipe lists of blacksmiths who'd already learned it.
Thunderbrew's Boot Flask was a quest reward from Sweet Amber.

Thuiljos is a Blizzard employee and an English language In-Game Customer Support Representative and Game Master for the European World of Warcraft community, normally encountered on the EU forums, specifically the [http://forums-en.wow-europe.com/ English WoW forums]. She is generally seen as the "boss" of the In-Game Customer Support Forums and in her own words "oversees all and pokes her nose in every now and then to lend a hand" [http://forums.wow-europe.com/thread.html?topicId=17792269&sid=1]. Thuiljos is known to randomly change her forum signature and often uses quotes from the TV show "Spaced" or the films "Shaun of the Dead" and "Hot Fuzz" (eg. 'Dogs can't look up', 'She said I had c
Throat Piercers is an thrown ranged weapon. This is a good level 19 twink item for Horde rogues.
Thundercaller's Gauntlets are a world drop from Outland mobs.
Thresher Eyes drop from Darkshore Threshers and Elder Darkshore Threshers in Darkshore.
Throne-Guard Sentinel were elite terrorguards located at the Throne of Kil'jaeden in Hellfire Peninsula.
Throne Hound were elite fel beasts found at the Throne of Kil'jaeden in Hellfire Peninsula.

Throne-Guard Champion were pit lords once found at the Throne of Kil'jaeden in Hellfire Peninsula. As of Patch 2.4, the Throne of Kil'jaeden underwent a revamping to make it more compatible with daily quests, as a result this mob was removed from game. (But Doom Lord Kazzak still remains.)
Throne-Guard Highlords were elite eredar found in the Throne of Kil'jaeden in the Hellfire Peninsula before the area underwent revamping.
This item is * a quest reward from Dancing for Marzipan (Horde). * an objective of Hallow's End Treats for Spoops!.

This is a list of all Thunder Bluff quests in table format (arranged by level). For a questing guide detailing the best order to obtain and complete quests in Thunder Bluff, see Thunder Bluff questing guide. The following quests can be found in Thunder Bluff:
Thule's Head drops from Thule Ravenclaw in Silverpine Forest.
Thuggish Shield drops from Thuros Lightfingers in Elwynn Forest.
Lizard Blood drops from the following thunder lizards in the Barrens: *Stormsnout *Thunderhead *Stormhide
Thunder Lizard Horn drops from the following thunder lizards in the Barrens: *Thunderhead *Stormsnout *Thunderstomp *Stormhide *Owatanka

Thugrim Seven-Eyes is an ogre magus shaman. He is a hero and commander of the Duskbelch tribe. He is intimidating but is a beloved commander (he is so well-loved by his troops that if he were to fall, it would ignite them into a savage fury).

A Thunder Bluff Gift Collection is a collection of the three Thunder Bluff pledge item packages, and is the second hierarchical combining of the pledge items given out by various Thunder Bluff NPCs during the Love is in the Air seasonal event. __NOTOC__
Through the Mirror Darkly is the 9th installment of the World of Warcraft comic.
The Thunderbrew Lager Keg is located in the Blackrock Depths. Breaking all of them will summon Hurley Blackbreath.

Crafters make these suits of thick hide armor from the skins of the thunder lizards that roam the Barrens. Each suit looks heavy and cumbersome, but once a character dons the armor he finds it is no more difficult to wear than regular hide. Thunder lizard tailspikes adorn the armor’s shoulder plates, and a black lightning bolt emblazons the breastplate.
Throwing Specialization is a Troll racial trait that increases chance to critically hit with throwing weapons by 1%.
Thunderbrew Apprentices are dwarves found during Brewfest, wherever Alliance brew kegs are located.
Thunderbrew Stout can be purchased for from during Brewfest.
Thunderbrew Ale can be purchased for from a during Brewfest.
Thrum is a dwarven explorer who found out, while on an adventure with a human and goblin, that goblin technology sometimes does not work, and can backfire.

Thrym is an elite flesh titan found in Zul'Drak. He patrols from the border of Crystalsong Forest to the second tier. Thrym was created from the corpses of local storm giants by Prince Navarius, a San'layn warlord who resides in Zul'Drak. During The Storm King's Vengeance, Thrym disappears until Navarius is killed, in which case he will attack.

Thudder the rabbit—along with Flora the skunk, Bambina the deer, and Mother of Bambina—all frolic together through the woods just west of the Westfall Brigade Encampment. Occasionally a spawns and kills Mother of Bambina, prompting a Vengeance filled Bambina to kill the hunter in response.

Thunderbrew Festive Keg can be found in Dun Morogh during the Brewfest holiday. Using your Yellow Brewfest Stein or Blue Brewfest Stein will fill them up, when you spend at least 10 seconds drinking it, you will gain a +8 Stamina and spirit Well Fed buff.

Thunderbrew Festive Wagon can be found in outside the Alliance major cities (except for Ironforge) during the Brewfest holiday. Using your Yellow Brewfest Stein or Blue Brewfest Stein will fill them up, when you spend at least 10 seconds drinking it, you will gain a +8 Stamina and spirit Well Fed buff.
One of three randomly created Mysterious Tarot cards, which when combined with the other two creates the Rogues Deck.

Thrym's End is an area in Zul'Drak where undead vrykul, or vargul, have been found preforming experiments for the Scourge. Gerk and Burr, members of an Argent Crusade in charge of establishing a battle front, can be found here, the remaining members can be found at Crusader Forward Camp. Gymer, the storm giant king, can also be found here in a gigantic cage.

A Thunder Bluff Pledge Collection is a package of five pledge gifts, and is the first hierarchical combining of the pledge items given out by various Thunder Bluff NPCs during the Love is in the Air seasonal event. All of the Love is in the Air pledge gift packages are non-functional as regards their name and picture. You cannot read a Thunder Bluff Pledge Collection. __NOTOC__
Thunder Bluff Gift of Friendship is a 60 minute +30 stamina buff gained after creating a from the three Thunder Bluff pledge item packages during the Love is in the Air event.
Thunder Bluff Civic Information is the visitor's center found in Thunder Bluff.
Thun'grim's Instructions are provided as an objective for Brutal Armor.
Thunder Bluff Commendation Badges may be purchased from for a cost of one Champion's Writ.
Thunderbomb's Jumpbot is a vehicle in the shape of a mechagnome found in Icecrown. It was built by Blast Thunderbomb.
The Thunderbrew are a dwarven family of ale makers, based in the Thunderbrew Distillery. They are rivals with the Barleybrews. They are predominately featured in the holiday event Brewfest.
Three of Mages is obtained randomly through Inscription, via the Arcane Tarot crafting item.
Three Sixty Pain Spike (10 player) is a dungeon & raids achievement earned for defeating Lord Jaraxxus while at least two Mistresses of Pain are alive on 10-player mode.
Three of Demons is created by scribes with Shadowy Tarot. It can be combined with the other four Demons cards to create a Demons Deck (starter).
Thunder Bluff Valiants are the valiant challengers of the Horde faction Thunder Bluff.

Throne of the Tides (or the Throne of Tides) is a five-player dungeon in the Abyssal Maw which is entered through the Abyssal Breach located in Vashj'ir, introduced in World of Warcraft: Cataclysm. The Throne of the Tides' entrance can be found at beneath the Abyssal Breach of the Abyssal Depths in Vashj'ir. Swimming into the watery cyclone will suffice entrance to the Abyssal Maw nexus where Throne of the Tides and the unreleased Abyssal Maw dungeon can be found.
Three of Swords is one of four randomly created Strange Tarot cards, which when combined with the other three creates the Swords Deck.

Throne of the Four Winds is a raid in the Skywall complex, introduced in World of Warcraft: Cataclysm. It can be found off the southwest coast of Uldum at high in the air. Along with Bastion of Twilight and Blackwing Descent, Throne of the Four Winds serves as an entry-level raiding instance, much as the level 80 version of Naxxramas was for Wrath of the Lich King and Karazhan was for the Burning Crusade.

The Throne of Flame is a massive lava pool in southern Mount Hyjal. Sulfuron Spire can be found at its center and magma giants around the area. Ascendant's Rise is on a cliff overlooking the lava lake.
Thunder Bluff Weapons is a weapon shop found on the lower rise of Thunder Bluff.
Thunder Bluff Armorers is an armor shop found on the middle rise of Thunder Bluff.
Thug Boots are the starting feet for orc, undead, and troll rogues.

Thunder Stones are found in the Stonehearth in Deepholm and can be collected from Stone Trogg Diggers or from a nearby caravan. This item is needed for catapults and is required to be collected for Thunder Stones.

Throne of the Apocalypse is an area within the Bastion of Twilight where Cho'gall resides. The throne itself is in a giant skull. When Cho'gall is vanquished, he stumbles and breaks the floor, leading to the Twilight Caverns.
Throne of the Four Winds Guild Run is an achievement that is awarded for defeating all bosses in the Throne of the Four Winds raid instance while in a guild group.
Throat-Slitter Gauntlets is a quest reward from Coup de Grace (quest).

A group of Thugs can be found behind the farmhouse of Furlbrow's Pumpkin Farm in Westfall. Initially neutral, they will turn hostile to any prying eyes who attempt to eavesdrop on their conversation. Along with the rest of Westfall, these riffraff are abuzz with rumors of a mysterious female figure who is attempting to resurrect the Defias Brotherhood. However, they know to keep their mouths shut and someone kills in a rather ironic fashion while the thugs are being dealt with.
The following NPCs can be found inside the Throne of the Tides instance.
The following NPCs can be found in Throne of the Four Winds.
Thunderbloom is an exotic plant well known for its unstable and dangerous properties. Chen Stormstout asked Rexxar to retrieve a sprig of thunderbloom as one of the ingredients for his brew.
Thunder Bluff Writs of Commendation are sold by Zen'Vorka at Malfurion's Breach in the Molten Front for .
Threshadon Chunk is a quest objective item for Thresh Out of Luck.

Thunder Cleft is a tauren encampment on the Dojani River in the eastern Krasarang Wilds. It was set up by the Dawnchaser tribe, led by Sunwalker Dezco, after they paddled upstream by canoe and were blocked from traveling further north by the cliffs of Winds' Edge. To the camp's east is the Krasari Ruins, just to the southeast is the Incursion, a night elf camp, and the Ruins of Dojan can be found to the south.

Thunder's Call is located on the northern end of the Isle of Reckoning, itself comprising the northeastern extent of Kun-Lai Summit. Prophet Khar'zul is using Thunder's Call to raise the Thunder King.

Thresher sharks, are a group of sharks, so named for and easily recognized by their exceptionally long caudal fins, living in waters of Azeroth. They were first added as part of the Cataclysm expansion.

The Thunder King Insignia is a common mogu archaeology artifact, created from 50xMogu Archaeology Fragment. Up to one Mogu Statue Piece may be used to solve this artifact. A pristine version can also be crafted.
Thresher Jaw drops from Longfin Threshers on the Shelf of Mazu in the Dread Wastes.
Thresher Teeth can be found inside Thresher Jaw looted from s on the Shelf of Mazu south of Dread Wastes.

Thunder Hold is an ancient mogu fortress found in the Honeydew Glade in the Jade Forest. It's here the Alliance have setup a base and begin attacking the Horde gunship, Hellscream's Fist, that comes to a stop nearby, after floating there when its engines were damaged. General Nazgrim leads ground forces from the backside and meets the heroes of the Horde, that charge in from the front side, inside the ruins. Meanwhile Captain Doren has barricaded himself on the upper floor, while his men are slaughtered below. General Nazgrim sends the heroes in a frontal assault while he and his marines scale the walls. As the Horde soldiers approach Captain Doren, he quickly escapes onto a gyrocopter and,
The Thunder-Laced Egg dropped for all players from Nalak, the Storm Lord in Isle of Thunder.

Thunder Plunder is a quest achievement earned for looting a Trove of the Thunder King, which can be found all over the Isle of Thunder. This achievement is required for the meta-achievement, Stormbreaker.
Throne of Thunder Guild Run is an achievement that is awarded for defeating all bosses in the Throne of Thunder raid instance while in a guild group.
Thunder Caressed Waistguard is purchased for at standing from the following vendors: * at Violet Rise * at Dawnseeker Promontory

__NOTOC__ Thunder Cleft Braves are tauren guards found at Thunder Cleft in Krasarang Wilds. They are part of the expedition to Pandaria led by Sunwalker Dezco. They wear Thunder Bluff Tabards and wield guns and two-handed axes in combat. They also appear at Stoneplow Fields in the Valley of the Four Winds fighting against Ik'thik mantid.
__NOTOC__ Thunder Cleft Sunwalkers are tauren located at Thunder Cleft in the Krasarang Wilds. They are part of the expedition to Pandaria led by Sunwalker Dezco.
Thunder Bluff Citizens were tauren located in Thunder Bluff. They were being recruited for the Twilight's Hammer.
Thresher Turrets are mechanical cannons seen in the Siege of Orgrimmar.
Thulgork's Orders drop from Thulgork for the quest Obtaining Ogre Offensive Orders.
Thromrok is a bound earth elemental located south of the Dreadmaul Post in Blasted Lands.
Throm'var is a Frostwolf village in northwestern Frostfire Ridge. The orcs were supplying the Horde with fine furs and supple leather.
Throm'var Landing is a slope leading from the sea below to Throm'var above in Frostfire Ridge.
Thruk's Fishing Rod is a fishing pole that drops from Thruk in Blackfathom Deeps.
Thruk's Heavy Duty Fishing Pole is a staff that drops from Thruk in Blackfathom Deeps.
Thruk's Fillet Knife is a dagger that drops from Thruk in Blackfathom Deeps.
The Throne of the Witch Lord is a platform at the tallest point in the Gordal Fortress in Talador. Witch Lord Morkurk leads the ogres from here.
The Thrice-Tanned Tunic is a world drop from level 94 - 97 mobs. It can also be looted from Big Crate of Salvage.
__NOTOC__ Thumping Demonheart Fetish drops from Mannoroth in .

Thunder Bluff Protectors are tauren guards found in Orgrimmar. Along with Darkspear Guardians and the traditional Orgrimmar Grunts, they replaced the Kor'kron guards after Garrosh's downfall. They can also be found in Razor Hill, where they, along with the Darkspear Guardians and Razor Hill Grunts, provide directions to various services in the village.
Throbbing Blood Orb summons a Blood Ritual Orb that applies a 1-minute buff which transforms the character into a Bleeding Hollow orc and allows the character to jump higher than normal.
Thunderbelly Mead is created with Ogre Brewing Kit, but is also a drop from Stomper Kreego and can be bought from many vendors on .

Thunder Bluff Braves are troops from Thunder Bluff following Baine Bloodhoof during The Battle for Broken Shore (Horde). They are also seen in Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar and in the Dranosh'ar Blockade in Durotar.

Thunder Bluff Natives are Thunder Bluff citizens appearing after the Battle for the Broken Shore. They are worried about the fate of their Warchief and can be seen discussing or crying with citizens from other Horde capitals.
Thunder Special is looted from Thunderbrew Special found on tables in Kharanos during Legion Invasions.

Thunder Bluff Skyspeakers are friendly tauren druids from Thunder Bluff that are at the Legion Invasion locations. Once saved, they can help the adventurers. They can only be saved by Horde adventurers.
Thunder's Plunder can drop from Coren Direbrew or be purchased for from during Brewfest.
Thrymjaris is a female storm drake located at Thorim's Peak in Stormheim. She is the broodmother of the Thorignir, the brood of the storm drakes allied with Odyn.

The Throne of the Imperator is the throne room of Highmaul. Three titan relics found by the empire, with space for a fourth, are displayed here. The King's Guard and Gorian War Council are stationed here.
Thrive in the Shadows is a Shadow priest artifact trait. It is linked to the From the Shadows (priest artifact trait) and To the Pain traits.

Thunder Bluff Warriors are tauren warriors that first showed up in Razor Hill during the Darkspear Rebellion. They later participated in the Siege of Orgrimmar and were seen at the Darkspear Offensive in front of the gates.
Thunder Hold Sharp-Shooters are dwarves located at Thunder Hold in the Jade Forest.

Thu'raya, Mother of the Cosmos is a shivarra boss located in the Temple of Anguish in Antorus, the Burning Throne. She is part of the mythic Coven of Shivarra encounter.

The Thunderdrome is the large cage arena in the center of Gadgetzan. It has one door on the north side. Fights are staged here for the entertainment of the populace - the bloodier the better! Interested parties should speak to the fight promoter Dr. Dealwell if they wish to participate. Katrina Turner is also involved in the management of the arena. It was closed down for a long time because of a series of injury lawsuits, racketeering charges, and copyright infringements.
Thrull was an ogre of the Mahrook clan who fought against the Alliance with his clansmen and his brother Throgg. He was killed when the enemies cornered the ogres into a canyon.

Thunder Bluff Shaman were tauren shaman that arrived to the Twilight Vale in Darkshore. They remained behind the wisp wall when the main Horde army took the Blackwood Den. During the Wildbend River stalemate, they were seen fighting the night elves at the Remtravel's Excavation. During the final phase, they attacked the night elven units stationed at Mist's Edge next to Lor'danel, and later gathered to witness the Burning of Teldrassil.

The Thromma pale is a group of pale orcs who have invaded Ironmonger's Hold and taken a large part of it from the Iron Horde. Belgork, an Iron Horde commander, is trying his best to deal with the pale and keep the tunnel open.
Throat-Ripper Gauntlets drop from Kargath Bladefist in Highmaul.
Thunder Bluff Tauren are tauren located in Arathi Highlands during the Battle for Stromgarde.
Thunder Phoenixes are phoenixes native to Durotar and appearing in the Founding of Durotar campaign. There are also lesser and greater phoenixes.
Throne of Kor'gall is a subzone of Gorgrond in the future. Kor'gall, Greatson of Kor'gall is located here.
Threshadon Flippers are bought from the Little Carp located in Deepfin Ridge in the Abyssal Depths.

The Thumpknuckles are a tribe of wild gorillas led by King Bagumba. They occupied Mugamba Overlook until it was taken by the Alliance.
Thumpknuckle Brute is a gorilla that was encountered by Alliance champions in Mugamba Overlook in Zuldazar.
Thunder Bluff Fireeaters were jungle trolls located in Thunder Bluff. They were replaced by Master Flame Eaters.
